deckTitle: Pattern B — Zero-Trust Sovereign Silos: Dedicated Projects, VPC-SC & CMEK Kill-Switch (Workstream 3)
deckSubtitle: How regulated financial, healthcare, and public-sector enterprises achieve physical Google Cloud project isolation, air-gapped Gemma 3 hosting, and a sub-60-second CMEK kill-switch while reusing 80% of the platform codebase
tldr: Meeting Strict Regulatory Sovereignty Mandates: Banking (OCC/FFIEC), healthcare (HIPAA), and sovereign cloud auditors frequently mandate zero shared compute, zero shared storage, and customer-revocable encryption keys.

80% Reusable ADK Codebase, 20% Dedicated Cloud Perimeter: Pattern B deploys the exact same 5-hop Python ADK 2.0 runtime inside a dedicated per-tenant Google Cloud project (`cymbal-finvault-silo-prod`).

Three Hardware-Enforced Perimeter Walls: Every tenant vault is locked by mTLS + IAM Principal Access Boundaries (PAB), a VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeter, and dedicated Cloud KMS Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK).

Sub-60-Second Customer CMEK Kill-Switch (`HTTP 423 Locked`): If a tenant Security Operations Center revokes or disables its Cloud KMS key, all Agent Engine memory, AlloyDB reads, and GKE inference halt immediately with HTTP 423.

Verified 6/6 Sovereign Compliance Suite & Terraform Blueprint: Ships with automated dual-silo security tests (`FinVault` + `RetailStream`), a 4-stage onboarding provisioner, and a 1-click Terraform silo blueprint (`3.6`).

sections.heading: Products used — VPC-SC, IAM PAB, Cloud KMS CMEK & Air-Gapped Gemma 3
bullets: Wall 1 — mTLS & IAM Principal Access Boundaries (PAB): Every request must present a pinned BeyondCorp client certificate (`cert_sha256`) and pass an IAM PAB rule binding the caller strictly to that tenant’s project.

Wall 2 — VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) Data Perimeter: Wraps Vertex AI, AlloyDB, Cloud Storage, GKE, and BigQuery inside a service perimeter that blocks unauthorized egress or cross-project copies (HTTP 403).
Wall 3 — Ubiquitous Cloud KMS CMEK Binding: A single tenant-managed Cloud KMS key encrypts AlloyDB tables, Vertex AI Memory Bank state, GKE persistent disks, and BigQuery audit datasets.

Flexible Sovereign Model Hosting: Tenants can run Gemini 2.5 Pro on Provisioned Throughput inside VPC-SC or deploy air-gapped Gemma 3 (27B) on a private GKE GPU node pool (`172.16.0.2/28`, zero public IPs).

sections.heading: Use cases — Regulated Banking, Healthcare & Defense on Sovereign Google Cloud Stack
bullets: The Regulated CISO Threat Model (Zero Physical Blast Radius): Tier-1 banks (OCC/FFIEC, EU DORA) and healthcare systems (HIPAA) mandate physically separate GCP projects (`cymbal-{tenant}-silo-prod`) with zero shared compute or databases.

FinVault Bank Sovereign Vault (`cymbal-finvault-silo-prod`): Runs air-gapped Gemma 3 (27B IT) on private GKE GPU nodes (`172.16.0.2/28`, 0 public IPs) alongside private Agent Alpha (Gemini 2.5 Pro Dedicated PT) and CMEK AlloyDB.

RetailStream Sovereign Vault (`cymbal-retailstream-silo-prod`): Demonstrates dual-silo parity with its own VPC Service Controls perimeter, IAM Principal Access Boundary (PAB), Entra ID 3LO connectors, and independent Cloud KMS CMEK key ring.

3-Wall Hardware Perimeter & <60s CMEK Kill-Switch Stack: BeyondCorp mTLS, IAM PAB, VPC-SC, Cloud KMS CMEK (`HTTP 423 Locked`), Model Armor, Cloud DLP, AlloyDB, and BigQuery wrap the unchanged 80% reusable ADK 2.0 core.

sections.heading: Design considerations — 5-Hop Cryptographic Pipeline Inside a Sovereign Silo

pipelineSteps.title: Client Certificate Pinning & Principal Access Boundary
pipelineSteps.mechanism: Verifies the caller’s X.509 client certificate SHA-256 fingerprint and evaluates IAM Principal Access Boundary policies before minting a silo-scoped OBO/DPoP token.
pipelineSteps.invariant: mTLS cert_sha256 Match + PAB Project == cymbal-{tenant}-silo-prod
pipelineSteps.gate: HTTP 401 on Unpinned Cert • HTTP 403 on Cross-Silo Principal

pipelineSteps.title: Project-Scoped Agent Registry & VPC-SC Ingress Check
pipelineSteps.mechanism: Combines VPC Service Controls perimeter validation with Hop 2 Agent Registry filtering so only connectors and agents provisioned inside the tenant silo can resolve.
pipelineSteps.invariant: VPC-SC Perimeter Match + Silo-Local MCP & Agent Endpoints
pipelineSteps.gate: HTTP 403 VPC_SC_VIOLATION on External Project Resource Call

pipelineSteps.title: Pre-Execution KMS Key Heartbeat & Air-Gapped Runtime
pipelineSteps.service: Cloud KMS CMEK • Private GKE / ADK
pipelineSteps.mechanism: Polls Cloud KMS CryptoKeyVersion state (`ENABLED` vs. `DISABLED`/`DESTROYED`) prior to hydrating L1–L5 Memory Bank or dispatching inference to private GKE Gemma 3.
pipelineSteps.invariant: KMS State == ENABLED • Private GKE Control Plane (172.16.0.2/28)
pipelineSteps.gate: HTTP 423 Locked Immediately When Tenant CMEK is Disabled

pipelineSteps.title: Dedicated In-Perimeter Model Armor & DLP Redaction
pipelineSteps.mechanism: Executes tenant-dedicated Model Armor floor templates, regulatory NLC policies (OCC/HIPAA), and Sensitive Data Protection masking inside the tenant’s VPC-SC boundary.
pipelineSteps.invariant: Silo-Dedicated Inspection Template + Regulatory NLC Enforcement
pipelineSteps.gate: HTTP 400 on Jailbreak • HTTP 422 on Regulatory NLC Breach

pipelineSteps.title: CMEK-Encrypted AlloyDB Instance & Sovereign Audit Sink
pipelineSteps.mechanism: Persists relational state in a dedicated CMEK-encrypted AlloyDB instance and writes immutable security and token telemetry to a silo-local BigQuery dataset.
pipelineSteps.invariant: Dedicated AlloyDB + Silo BigQuery Encrypted by Tenant KMS Key
pipelineSteps.gate: HTTP 423 Storage Halt on Key Revocation • 100% In-Silo Audit

bullets: Hop 1 — Hardware mTLS & IAM PAB: Validates client certificate fingerprints and blocks any principal attempting to cross into another tenant’s cloud project.
Hop 2 — VPC-SC & Silo Registry: Ensures agent tool discovery and MCP calls cannot egress the tenant’s VPC Service Controls perimeter.
Hop 3 — Live Cloud KMS Heartbeat: Verifies CMEK key state before every turn, halting memory and inference with HTTP 423 Locked within 60 seconds of key revocation.
Hop 4 — Dedicated Model Armor & DLP: Enforces regulatory NLCs and PII redaction using templates hosted inside the tenant’s sovereign project.
Hop 5 — CMEK AlloyDB & BigQuery Audit: Encrypts all relational tables and OTel audit logs with the tenant’s Cloud KMS key.

diagrams.title: Pattern B: Zero-Trust Sovereign Silos (VPC-SC, IAM PAB, CMEK & Air-Gapped Gemma 3 on GKE)
talkingPoints: Enterprise callers authenticate at Step 1 with pinned BeyondCorp mTLS certificates and receive a silo-isolated response at Step 7 (or HTTP 423 if CMEK is revoked).
Zone 1 (Silo Ingress & Identity): Validates mTLS device certificates, enforces IAM Principal Access Boundaries, and screens prompts with Model Armor.
Zone 2 (Sovereign Governance Hub): Monitors VPC Service Controls perimeters, polls Cloud KMS CMEK liveness on every turn, and runs all 6 compliance assertions.
Zone 3 (FinVault Sovereign Project): Dedicated GCP project running air-gapped Gemma 3 (27B) on private GKE and CMEK-encrypted AlloyDB/Memory Bank.
Zone 4 (RetailStream Sovereign Project): Dedicated GCP project running Provisioned Throughput Gemini 2.5 Pro and isolated Entra ID / ServiceNow 3LO.

diagrams.title: Pattern B Provisioning Topology: Org → Per-Tenant Silo Projects, VPC-SC, IAM PAB & CMEK
talkingPoints: Illustrates the 4-stage automated onboarding factory that provisions a physically isolated Google Cloud project for each regulated enterprise tenant.
Zone 1 (Stage 1 — Project & APIs): Creates `cymbal-{tenant}-silo-prod` under the enterprise folder and enables Vertex AI, AlloyDB, GKE, and Cloud KMS.
Zone 2 (Stage 2 — Tenant CMEK): Provisions a dedicated Cloud KMS key ring and 90-day rotating crypto key bound exclusively to the tenant silo.
Zone 3 (Stage 3 — Perimeter Lock): Attaches the IAM Principal Access Boundary and wraps all 8 APIs in a VPC Service Controls perimeter.
Zone 4 (Stage 4 — Live Compliance Gate): Executes the 6-point sovereign security test suite (`6/6 PASS`) before releasing the vault to production traffic.

diagrams.title: Pattern B Terraform Resource Graph: KMS CMEK → VPC-SC Perimeter → Sovereign VPC → Private GKE
talkingPoints: Maps the declarative Terraform resource graph (`3.6-terraform-silo-blueprint/main.tf`) parameterized by 5 tenant input variables.
Zone 1 (Cryptographic Root): Provisions `google_kms_key_ring` and `google_kms_crypto_key` with 90-day rotation and service-agent IAM bindings.
Zone 2 (VPC-SC Perimeter): Provisions `google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter` locking down Vertex AI, AlloyDB, GCS, GKE, and BigQuery.
Zone 3 (Isolated Sovereign VPC): Provisions `google_compute_network` and `10.30.0.0/20` subnet with Private Google Access and zero public internet routes.
Zone 4 (Air-Gapped GKE Inference): Deploys `google_container_cluster` (`enable_private_nodes = true`, `/28` master CIDR, CMEK boot/etcd disks) for Gemma 3.

takeaways: Deploy Pattern B When Contracts Mandate Physical Isolation or CMEK Kill-Switches: Satisfy banking, healthcare, and public-sector auditors with dedicated projects, VPC-SC, and customer-revocable keys.
Reuse 80% of the Core Agent Codebase Across All Silos: Parameterize project IDs, KMS key URIs, and model endpoints via configuration so engineering maintains a single software release train.

Combine Identity (IAM PAB) and Network (VPC-SC) Perimeters: Pairing Principal Access Boundaries with VPC Service Controls prevents both credential reuse outside the silo and data exfiltration from inside.
Bind Compute, Memory, and Storage to One Tenant CMEK Lever: Validating Cloud KMS key state on every turn guarantees a deterministic sub-60-second HTTP 423 kill-switch across the entire stack.
Certify Every Silo Before Go-Live with Automated Tests: Run `run_silo_security_tests.py` (`6/6 PASS`) during tenant onboarding to hand customer CISOs an auditable verification receipt.
